title: Plain prefix after its first bit
statement: For Boolean words $x$ and $u$, a natural number $r$, and a bit $b$, $x$ agrees with the word $b::u$ starting at position $r$ and has length $r+|b::u|$ if and only if $x_r=b$ and $x$ agrees with $u$ starting at position $r+1$ and has length $(r+1)+|u|$. Here out-of-range entries are read as false.
